title: Crate
summary: An open-front box for bins, with a baseplate grid inside. Crates stack on each other and on baseplates, and take bins on top, so they make cubbies on a shelf, bench or countertop.

groups.title: Size
groups.help: The grid inside, in 42 mm squares, and the height of the bins it holds in 7 mm units. The crate is that grid plus its walls.

groups.title: Walls & floor
groups.help: Thicker walls and plates make a stiffer crate; thinner ones print faster and lighter.

groups.title: Stacking
groups.help: Feet underneath and pockets on top use the Gridfinity grid, so crates stack on each other, sit on a baseplate, and bins sit on top.

params.label: Width
params.help: Grid squares inside, across the front.

params.label: Depth
params.help: Grid squares inside, front to back.

params.label: Bin height
params.help: Height of the tallest bins it should hold, in 7 mm units (the same number as the bin's height).

params.label: Headroom
params.help: Space above the bins' stacking lip. At least 5 mm lets a bin lift out of the grid and slide out the front.

params.label: Floor thickness
params.help: Solid floor under the grid inside.

params.label: Top thickness
params.help: Solid top above the opening (under the stacking pockets).

params.label: Solid back
params.help: Turn off for an open back with an 8 mm frame: lighter, and you can reach through.

params.label: Feet
params.help: Gridfinity feet under every square, so the crate locks onto a baseplate or another crate. Turn off for a flat bottom.

params.label: Stacking top
params.help: Baseplate pockets on top, so crates and bins stack on it. Turn off for a flat top.
